subtitle: Lesson 26 · Monitoring & Cost Management

code:
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where ActivityStatusValue == "Success"
| summarize count() by OperationNameValue
caption: The same query language that powers Microsoft Sentinel in the Cybersecurity path.

code:
AzureActivity
| where OperationNameValue has "deallocate"
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, ResourceId
caption: Metrics show the VM is off. The Activity Log shows who turned it off, and when.
